name: Obadiah
summary: The shortest book of the Old Testament: an oracle against Edom for gloating over and joining in Jerusalem's fall.

evidence.note: Obad 11–14 describes Edom standing by, looting and handing over fugitives as Jerusalem fell, best matching 586 (compare Ps 137:7; Lam 4:21–22).

dating.notes: The book has no superscription date.

evidence.note: Links the oracle to the Philistine and Arab raid on Jerusalem and the revolt of Edom under Jehoram (2 Kgs 8:20–22; 2 Chr 21:16–17).

dating.notes: Position surveyed in the cited commentary.
